high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot from an article or a webpage discussing the "Fantastic Four" movie. It also mentions the spacesuits worn by the characters, noting that there are two types: initial spacesuits that left them vulnerable to cosmic radiation on their first space trip, and new spacesuits with a sleek blue design.
